adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService, the code changes from `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` to `parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)` and then persists the returned value directly as `key` in Prisma. But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns a Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed credential data. This means the DB can be updated with the wrapper object instead of the credential payload, corrupting stored credentials. Additionally, when sync is enabled it validates against the looser `minimumTokenResponseSchema` (and may inject a dummy `refresh_token`), so it can overwrite previously valid credentials with a reduced/incorrect shape.
